BREAKING: SpaceX is asking the FCC to reconsider a $4.5B rural broadband subsidy program saying Starlink has already closed much of the connectivity gap across the US.

In a new filing, SpaceX says legacy support programs were built for a time when high-speed internet in rural America was far more limited.

The company revealed it launched over 3,000 Starlink satellites in 2025 adding more than 270 Tbps of capacity with launches continuing at a similar pace in 2026.

SpaceX also says upcoming Gen-3 satellites could deliver 10x more downlink capacity and 24x more uplink capacity compared to current Starlink satellites.

Combined with the FCC’s new spectrum sharing rules Starlink could soon support even more users with faster speeds across rural areas.

Grok Imagine (Video) is now ranked among the top video generation models on DesignArena’s Video Arena benchmark

The model achieved a 1309 Elo rating — outperforming:
• Veo 3 Fast
• Kling v3 Pro
• Sora 2 Pro
• Wan 2.7

What’s notable is how quickly Grok’s multimodal ecosystem is expanding, with its video generation model already competing alongside some of the strongest frontier video systems in the industry.

Grok Voice Think Fast is now among the top-performing realtime voice models on AudioAgentBench

The model scored 75.9% ranking ahead of:
• Gemini 2.5 Flash Live
• GPT Realtime 1.5
• GPT Realtime 2
• Nova Sonic 2

What’s interesting is how competitive Grok’s voice stack has become in realtime conversational performance, especially as the race for low-latency AI assistants continues to accelerate.
